lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Horizontal alignment of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately five discernible rows on the mid-lateral flank between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a lattice-like geometric pattern on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges exhibiting high-contrast vertical luminance gradients, running parallel to the dorsal midline across the upper third of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10-12 circular high-intensity pixel clusters distributed across the first dorsal fin's silhouette, with a higher concentration observed toward the posterior base of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or loss of tissue is visible on the posterior (trailing) edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense constellation of smaller, high-frequency luminance spots is localized on the cephalic region anterior to the gill slits, transitioning to larger, more spaced-out blobs on the trunk.
